q: WITH pgrst_source AS ( SELECT "public"."tags".* FROM "public"."tags"   LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2 )  SELECT $3::bigint AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM ( SELECT * FROM pgrst_source ) _postgrest_t

WITH pgrst_source AS ( SELECT "public"."tags".* FROM "public"."tags"   LIMIT $1 OFFSET $2 ) , pgrst_source_count AS (SELECT $3  FROM "public"."tags") SELECT (SELECT pg_catalog.count(*) FROM pgrst_source_count) AS total_result_set, pg_catalog.count(_postgrest_t) AS page_total, coalesce(json_agg(_postgrest_t), $4) AS body, nullif(current_setting($5, $6), $7) AS response_headers, nullif(current_setting($8, $9), $10) AS response_status, $11 AS response_inserted FROM ( SELECT * FROM pgrst_source ) _postgrest_t
